instruction: Align the subtitle text to the center on the current slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires center aligning the subtitle text (the long description starting with 'Art is a diverse range...'). The custom getter extracts the text alignment of the subtitle paragraph. The metric compares it against the expected alignment (CENTER).
